7210705680570833565: "High Mountains and Flowing Water" is one of China's Ten Great Ancient Melodies. Originally a single piece, it was split into two independent qin compositions after the Tang Dynasty. The score first appeared in the Ming Dynasty's "Mysterious and Secret Tablature." The phrase "high mountains and flowing water" originates from "Liezi·Tang Wen," recounting the legend of Boya, a master qin player, and Zhong Ziqi, a keen listener. When Boya played with mountains in mind, Ziqi praised, "How majestic, like Mount Tai!" When he played with flowing water, Ziqi said, "How vast, like rivers and seas!" Boya's thoughts were always understood by Ziqi. After Ziqi's death, Boya broke his qin and severed its strings, declaring no one else could appreciate his music, and never played again.

Where peace holds firm, hunger holds no name. 
When he hijacked Shen Yilun upon his return from the southern tour, when he imprisoned Shen deep underground, when he assumed the role of Master of Grain in another man's name, Zheng E gently brushed the old fan his childhood friend once gave him. Again and again, he recalled the promise they made in their youth... And let out a mocking laugh. 
The ruthless seize fertile lands, the cold-blooded survive plagues. 
The ungrateful rise to power, while the kind-hearted lose their homes, their lives, and all they hold dear. 
With the world as it is, how could he cling to any notion of goodness? 
The blood debt from twelve years ago, he would settle it himself. 
As for his naive old friend, let him remain blind. Let him hate. It no longer mattered. 
His days were numbered, and this was the only path left to walk.

Players must abide by the Where Winds Meet General Tournament Rules. See the [General Tournament Rules] section on the official Where Winds Meet Tournament Center website. 

The max Gear Tier for this "Contention Tournament" is Tier 86. Wanderers must keep their Tier 86 [Gear]. Combat attributes will be balanced during the match (Character and Martial Arts Level 90, Inner Ways Tier 6, Mystic Skill Tier 5 Rank 9, Gear Enhancement max 45 stacks, all current season general Arena Talents unlocked). Combat rules follow the 5v5 Arena rules. 

Teams registered during the Qualifiers period must proceed to the Contention Tournament Qualifiers interface to match. Complete 10 qualifying matches. Result review period is 24h, ending the next day at 16:30. The top 32 teams advance to the next stage. 

Participating teams can form a team and enter the preparation scene via the leader 15 minutes before the Group Stage match starts (ensure all 5 members are in the team). Qualifying teams are divided into 4 groups for a Single Round Robin tournament, using a Best of 3 format. 
[1] Matchmaking: The system will automatically match teams against opponents they haven't fought yet starting at 14:00. Groups with an odd number of teams may experience longer wait times due to byes. 
[2] Process: After returning to the preparation scene, the system will continue to match for the next round. Wait times may be longer as it only matches opponents not yet fought. Please wait patiently. 
[3] Round Robin: Teams must complete a match against every other team in the group. The Group Stage ends when all teams have fought each other. 
The review period ends on July 8 at 22:00. The 1st place of each group advances to the Top 8 Winners Bracket, and the 2nd place advances to the Top 8 Losers Bracket. Rewards are claimed after the review period. 

Team Ranking Criteria (Priority): Total Wins > Avg. Survivors in Wins > Avg. Time in Wins (Calculated using only valid winning matches, excluding byes).
